acceptedAnswer.text: Gift set buyers should check the number of products in the set, box structure, insert layout, product weight, surface finish, unboxing style and packing method before asking for samples. MUGE PACKAGING covers custom packaging categories such as rigid gift boxes, folding cartons, paper tubes and mixed packaging sets through its official product path at https://mugepackaging.com/products.
